verses.1: And Pashhur son of Immer, the priest and judge in the house of God, heard these words from Yerimiah.
verses.2: And Pashhur killed the prophet Jeremiah. He then handed him over to those who would execute him at the gate of Benjamin, which is located in the house of Jehovah.
verses.3: And in the evening, Pashhur went out from the place of the revolution. He said to Jeremiah, “Jeremiah, do not be afraid! Call upon the name of the LORD, for I am a prisoner from afar.”
verses.4: For as Jehovah said, “I will give you a prison for yourself and for all your lovers. They will fall into their own destruction. Your eyes shall see all of Israel, and I will hand them over to the king of Babylon. He will destroy them completely.”
verses.5: And I will give to this city all its blessings, along with all its wealth and treasures. All the possessions of the kings of Judah will be given into their hands. They can take them away and carry them away with them.
verses.6: And you, Pashhur, and all the inhabitants of your house, you shall go into the wilderness. There you will die and be buried. You and all your lovers who were brought to you in falsehood.
verses.7: May the LORD strengthen me, and may He make me strong. I will be able to sing today, just as I always have. All of this is for my joy.
verses.8: For I will cry out in pain and sorrow, for it is the word of the LORD that brings me shame and destruction every day.
verses.9: And I said that I would not remember him, and I would not speak of him anymore. In my heart, he was like a fire in a forest of thorns. I was filled with sorrow and despair, and I could not bear it any longer.
verses.10: For I have heard the words of many people from all around. They say, “Let us all be punished; let us be destroyed by everyone who protects our borders.” But let them be destroyed, and let their punishment be taken from them.
verses.11: And Jehovah made me a tyrant over them. Therefore, they were doomed to fail and never succeed. They couldn’t overcome me at all, because they didn’t understand me at all. I will never give up.
verses.12: And Jehovah will judge the righteous with fairness. I will see their suffering and their hearts. I will avenge you from them, for I have delivered you from your enemies.
verses.13: Praise Jehovah! Praise Him, for He has saved our father from the hands of his enemies.
verses.14: May the day I was born be blessed. It is a day when my mother gave me life, so that I may be happy.
verses.15: The man who anointed my father said, “A male child has been born to you; let us rejoice.”
verses.16: And that man would be like cities that have been turned into ruins by Jehovah. He would not be comforted, and he would hear the cries in the morning and the wails at sunset.
verses.17: Whoever does not show me mercy, my mother will be my burial place. May there be eternal mercy for her.
verses.18: Why did I go out into this hardship? I went there to see suffering and pain. My days were filled with sorrow and suffering.
